materiality.reason: The persisted completion records a substantial focused multi-source inventory, structured plugin and asset validation, an execution decision about source authority, and residual runtime gaps.

capture.reason: Material provider-neutral knowledge was derived from the authorized persisted sources.
capture.minimum_next_path: Review and deduplicate only through loki-continuous-improvement.

claim.statement: The context handoff completed a focused read-only inventory spanning the demand, RPG Maker runtime data, plugin configuration, engine commands, routed documentation, quest notes, and asset metadata.
The inventory validations included structured parsing, plugin envelope and VM extraction, command inventory, and checks of asset existence and dimensions.
Observed runtime facts take precedence over unreviewed historical notes, while conflicts remain explicit gates.
The inventory alone does not validate perceptible runtime behavior; that behavior remains pending.
A reusable context-inventory pass benefits from combining authoritative runtime inspection with narrowly routed documentation, while preserving unresolved conflicts as gates.

attempt.action: Perform a focused multi-source inventory before the first POV wave.
attempt.outcome: The handoff completed with a scene baseline, ownership boundaries, branches, assets, conflicts, and human gates; no production files were changed.

resolution.statement: The inventory resolved the context baseline sufficiently for POV wave 1, but perceptible behavior still requires runtime validation.

cause.statement: The remaining uncertainty follows from the handoff being read-only and from observable behavior not yet being exercised at runtime.

gaps.gap: Evidence completeness is partial for tool I/O and unavailable for transcript and run-scoped token usage.

knowledge.minimum_next_path: Use the persisted inventory as bounded context for POV wave 1, then validate any perceptible behavior in the appropriate runtime gate.
knowledge.reuse_guidance: For comparable RPG Maker context passes, inspect runtime data and plugin configuration alongside narrowly routed documentation, validate structured plugin and asset facts, and keep source conflicts explicit.
knowledge.avoid_next_time: Do not treat unreviewed historical notes as stronger evidence than current runtime facts, and do not infer perceptible runtime behavior from a read-only inventory.
